categories.name: AI Coding Editors & Agents
categories.headline: Best AI Coding Agents & Editors
categories.description: IDEs and terminal agents that write, refactor and ship code with you.
categories.intro: The best AI coding tool for most builders in 2026 is Cursor: an AI-first editor with a strong agent mode and a free plan to start. Pick Claude Code for large refactors and long-running terminal tasks, OpenAI Codex if you already pay for ChatGPT and want to hand tasks off to the cloud, and GitHub Copilot if your team lives in GitHub. Want free and open source? Use Cline or Aider with your own API key.

tools.pricingNote: Free plan; Plus $8/mo (Grok models only); Premium $30/mo, Super $100/mo, Ultra $200/mo; Teams from $30/user/mo; third-party models at API list price on Premium+

categories.intro: The best AI app builder for most people is Lovable: describe your app in chat and get a polished, full-stack web app with a free plan to try it. Bolt.new is the fastest way to spin up a full-stack prototype in the browser, v0 is best for React/Next.js UI that deploys to Vercel, and Replit is best if you want to build and host in one place. For internal tools with built-in auth and data, try Base44.

categories.headline: Best AI Image Generators
categories.description: Models and apps for generating and editing images.
categories.intro: The best AI image generator for raw aesthetics is Midjourney (paid only, from $10/mo). For images with readable text and step-by-step edits, use GPT Image in ChatGPT; for fast conversational editing, use Nano Banana in Gemini (both have free usage). Ideogram is the pick for logos and posters with typography, and Recraft for vector icons and brand-consistent assets.

categories.intro: The best AI agent framework for TypeScript and Next.js builders is the Vercel AI SDK; for Python, start with the OpenAI Agents SDK or Pydantic AI. All of these are free, open-source libraries; you pay only for model usage.

releases.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra: a fast, cheaper model for computer use, visual reasoning and coding (50.3% Terminal-Bench 4.0 at max effort), $1/$5 per 1M tokens, in ChatGPT, Codex and the API as gpt-6.1-terra
Runway launches App Studio: describe a creative tool in plain language and it builds, tests and hosts a shareable app that uses Runway's image, video and audio models; included in all paid plans

Entire (from ex-GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke) launches an agent-first Git forge for every developer: Trails replace pull requests with agent-scored evals, plus Continuous Memory for coding agents and Buildkite/Depot CI
Nanbeige releases Nanbeige4.3-33B open weights (Apache 2.0): a 33B agentic coding model with 512K context that tops its size class on Terminal-Bench in the lab's own tests
Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro: 3T-class model with 1M context for coding and agents, $2/$10 per 1M tokens via the Kimi API (Highspeed variant 2-3x faster); full open weights due by Nov 4
Replit launches Monitoring Agent: an autonomous on-call engineer that triages production alerts from your app's logs and metrics, then attempts and validates fixes
OpenAI adds scheduled automations to the Agents API (beta): run agents on a cron schedule or at a future time, and let agents manage their own schedules
Ideogram launches Vector 1.0: editable SVGs from a prompt or any image, in the app and API ($0.10–$0.32 per SVG)
Canva launches Craft, its first in-house image model: 2K images in 30+ aspect ratios, free for all Canva users and in the public API
OpenAI Decisions API is generally available on GPT-6 Luna: fast classification/routing calls at $0.10 per 1M input tokens, no output charges
Anthropic donates the Agent Skills (SKILL.md) open standard to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, MCP's home
Google Cloud announces Agent Compute Engine: hardware-isolated microVM sandboxes for running AI agents (preview in coming months)
Microsoft starts rolling out Copilot Code: build and publish apps from plain-language prompts inside Microsoft Copilot (Frontier preview)
Anthropic opens Claude Duet research preview: proactive background agent app on Opus 5.5 (US Pro/Max waitlist)
Recursive releases Flint: 40B MoE (2.5B active) local coding model, Apache 2.0, 125+ tok/s on an M4 Pro MacBook
OpenAI's GPT-6 models and Codex workflows coming to Google Cloud Model Garden (private preview)
Cursor releases the Agent SDK (GA): define agents as code with Markdown prompts and TypeScript tools, test with evals and event replay, then deploy to Cursor with one command or self-host
ElevenLabs launches Eleven Realtime v1 Mini and Max: speech-to-speech voice agent models in 90+ languages, compatible with OpenAI's Realtime API
Mistral launches Voxtral 3 speech-to-text and TTS models plus a voice agent SDK
OpenAI API adds 12-hour prompt caching for long-running agents
MiniMax M3.1 Flash GA: faster, cheaper agentic + coding model ($0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens)
Inception launches Mercury 3 diffusion LLM (1,000+ tok/s, 1M context)
OpenAI: GPT-6 Astra hits 87.4% on new MultiLangBench for COBOL, Fortran, Visual Basic
Meta releases Muse Glimmer 30B on-device agentic model (Apache 2.0)
Vercel open-sources durable-harness: run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi agents durably
DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 open weights
Meta releases Muse Spark Open weights
Kling 4.0 launches with 30-second single-pass video and 15-asset Omni Reference
Gemini 4 Argon generally available
Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5
Mistral Large 4 public preview; Nano Banana 2.1 (via release tracker)
